subject: [PATCH] mm/page_alloc: let the highest memory node recover from hopeless state

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the patch's premise and implementation, questioning why it didn't remove a re-wake event and how it can be at fault for kswapd getting stuck.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Clarified the patch's intention and explained why it didn't fully fix the issue, but acknowledged that it needs further work.

2026-10-19.patch_summary: The patch aims to let the highest memory node recover from a hopeless state, but its implementation is questioned by reviewers.
